description: React component definitions for a dropdown menu UI, utilizing radix-ui primitives and lucide icons, with custom styling and forwarding refs.

classes.name: DropdownMenuSubTrigger
classes.description: A React component for the submenu trigger with optional inset styling.

classes.name: DropdownMenuSubContent
classes.description: A React component for the submenu content with animated and styled dropdown behavior.

classes.name: DropdownMenuContent
classes.description: A React component for the main dropdown content with positioning and animation.

classes.name: DropdownMenuItem
classes.description: A React component for individual dropdown items.

classes.name: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
classes.description: A React component for checkbox items within the dropdown.

classes.name: DropdownMenuRadioItem
classes.description: A React component for radio button items within the dropdown.

classes.name: DropdownMenuLabel
classes.description: A React component for labeling sections within the dropdown.

classes.name: DropdownMenuSeparator
classes.description: A React component for visual separation between dropdown items.

classes.name: DropdownMenuShortcut
classes.description: A component for displaying shortcut hints in the dropdown.
